description: Statistics Netherlands, which also serves as the statistics office for the Caribbean Netherlands, publishes a StatLine table on electricity and piped water for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba. It counts connections to the electricity and drinking water networks for households and businesses, splits household electricity connections into prepaid and postpaid on Bonaire, and gives electricity production from fossil and renewable sources and drinking water production. For 2024 the three islands had 16,863 electricity connections and produced 200.3 million kWh, of which 48.8 million kWh was renewable; Bonaire alone had 12,536 water connections. Coverage is each island and the total, from 1993 to 2025 with gaps. Format and access: free OData API and StatLine downloads, no key. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: this comes from utility and administrative sources, not a population census; some cells are empty, such as Saba water connections; the cbs.nl main site returned a gateway timeout when first tried. Simulation uses: island electricity and water demand and connection counts for small island grid and desalination planning, and the renewable share for energy transition studies. Related records: none for these islands in the catalogue.
